t: You're standing at St Thomas More Language College, a Roman Catholic secondary school in Chelsea, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It's named after Thomas More, who lived in Chelsea, which is why the name belongs here. More was a lawyer, a Renaissance humanist and the author of Utopia, published in 1516. He served Henry VIII as Lord Chancellor from 1529 to 1532, and was later beheaded by the king. The Catholic Church venerates him as a martyr and saint.
